user.title: Translink Queensland
user.description: Choose whether to track a Journey between an origin and destination, or a Station/Stop departure board.

journey.description: Specify the Starting Point and Destination for realtime journey tracking across South East Queensland.

data_description.transport_modes: Select public transport modes to include in routing.
data_description.track_vehicle: Create a live GPS device tracker for the active transit vehicle.

stop.title: Configure Stop Departure Board

data_description.transport_modes: Modes to monitor from this stop.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Translink
reconfigure.description: Update location and transport settings for this Translink entry.
